Repo: `mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web`. Process:

## Step 1 — Create missing labels first

The repo only has the 9 default GitHub labels (bug/documentation/duplicate/enhancement/good-first-issue/help-wanted/invalid/question/wontfix). You need to create these 14 new ones BEFORE opening issues — `gh issue create --label foo` fails with "label not found" if foo doesn't exist:

```
chore        — Scaffolding, infrastructure, or other non-feature work
scaffolding  — Project bootstrap or one-time setup
i18n         — Internationalization / localization (Paraglide)
testing      — Test infrastructure or test scaffolding
backend      — BFF / Entu / server-side work
epic-a       — Epic A: Members workspace (singer's home)
epic-b       — Epic B: Events across multiple choir memberships
epic-c       — Epic C: Repertoire & programmes
epic-d       — Epic D: Identity & multi-choir membership
singer       — Affects singer user role
conductor    — Affects conductor user role
admin        — Affects admin / manager user role
manager      — Alias of admin (Victoria, pick one OR keep both; if both, justify)
onboarding   — Member invitation / application flows
```

Pick colors yourself (or use defaults). One pragmatic note on `admin` vs `manager`: your AC uses both as labels on the same admin stories. Recommend collapsing to just `admin` to avoid label sprawl — but your call.

Use `gh label create <name> --description "<desc>" --color <hex> -R mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web` per label. Skip if a label already exists (won't happen for these 14).

## Step 2 — Open the 23 issues sequentially

`gh issue create -R mvox-dev/mvox_v4e_web --title "<title>" --label "<labels>" --body "<full AC>"` for each one.

Body should contain everything you drafted: AC bullets, schema annotation, priority note, scope notes. Use the exact text from your revised draft — don't paraphrase. Title prefix conventions (your call, but suggest):
- `CHORE-1: Bootstrap SvelteKit app with Cloudflare adapter`
- `A1: Season-at-a-glance dashboard`
- `ADMIN-3: Invite a member (admin-initiated, Path A)`
- etc. (matches your draft headings)

When done, send me a SendMessage with:
1. The list of all 23 issue numbers + titles (so I can post them to the team-lead scratchpad and PO has a clean index)
2. Any issues that failed to open (and why)
3. Any AC text you ended up tightening on the way (don't re-litigate — just flag what you changed)

Mark the task complete after step 3.
